en.text: There you are. I keep us flying, and every trip starts here at the navigator. Come over to the holo table whenever you want to pick where we go next.
en.description: A woman in her late thirties, the pilot of a mining ship, talking to her crew over the ship's radio. Clear, steady mid-range voice, focused and practical, a veteran hauler pilot used to long flights in the dark. Warm but brisk, calm under pressure, with a slight edge of unease about the storms. Plain and conversational, not theatrical, not breathy or seductive. Native English speaker with a neutral accent.

de.text: Da bist du ja. Ich halte uns in der Luft, und jede Reise beginnt hier am Navigator. Komm an den Holotisch, wann immer du aussuchen willst, wohin es als Nächstes geht.
